stem: What happens next in this passage after “What if a drone fell?”?
options: A smart traffic light used cameras and sensors to adjust waiting time.
What if cameras recorded people's yards?
Many people recorded, but the mood had changed.
Students at a technology workshop received small stickers to cover laptop cameras.
